title: A linear residual structure across galaxy rotation curves (Hosik Lee, SPARC + LITTLE THINGS)
efc_relevance: Identifies a universal linear residual across SPARC + LITTLE THINGS decomposable into a mass-coupled and a mass-independent component. The slope/intercept pair is a direct, falsifiable target for EFC's sealed SPARC k = 0.415 universality prediction (ledger_galaxy_rotation_curves_sparc) and sits in the same probe family as arXiv:2604.27320 and arXiv:2605.23302.
ledger_action: Re-run EFC SPARC pipeline (seed=42, k=0.415 sealed) on the linear-residual decomposition; add to Validation Ledger alongside arXiv:2411.13329 and arXiv:2604.27320; update gap theory-multicomponent-sparc-universality with residual-slope/intercept row.
